moments.title: August UK Weather Outlook
moments.blurb: The UK is set for a settled start to August with dry weather and sunny spells, though showers may affect the North. Temperatures are expected to remain above normal, with potential for further hot spells later in the month, especially in the South.

angles.name: Summer Continues
angles.copy: Hello, August! Looks like a settled start to the month with plenty of sunshine for many. Are you making the most of the summer weather?

angles.name: Heatwave Watch
angles.copy: Forecasts suggest more hot spells could be on the way for the South later in August, while the North sees more showers. What's the weather like where you are?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: News continues to circulate about the 2026 FA Community Shield between Arsenal and Manchester City, which will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on August 16th, marking its return to the Welsh capital after 20 years due to Wembley's unavailability.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Football

angles.name: Principality Stadium Buzz
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium will host the Community Shield this year! It's the first time in 20 years the football curtain-raiser has been held in the Welsh capital.
